verdict.rationale: incident.io documents public and private Status Pages, which can be auto-published from incidents via Workflows. AI Suggestions also drafts incident updates and summaries. Together these provide structured updates outside the incident channel, but the evidence frames status pages as customer communication and never documents internal stakeholders subscribing to updates. missing for 10: explicit internal-stakeholder subscription mechanism (email/Slack subscribe to incident updates), documentation of private status pages targeting internal audiences, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, internal stakeholders get structured incident updates they can subscribe to, without joining the war room

citations.quote: We've built an easy and delightful way to communicate with customers during an incident with our public and private Status Pages.
With Workflows, you can automatically publish to your status page when an incident is updated.
Suggestions uses AI to help teams communicate better during incidents by automatically drafting updates, summaries and follow-up actions
You can choose how summaries and updates are written across your organization
